caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular mosaic design bordered by several rows of squares in alternating red, green, and white colors, with thin black lines separating the tiles to form a grid pattern. Within this border, the central part of the mosaic features a symmetrical arrangement of repeating geometric and curved motifs. There is a circular medallion in the middle composed of small, irregularly shaped tesserae in shades of blue, yellow, red, and white, forming a swirling abstract design. Flanking the medallion on either side, there are pairs of mirrored red scroll patterns, each outlined in black, with smaller fill patterns in white, yellow, and some touches of blue. These scrolls are separated from green, looping, interlaced designs found at both ends of the rectangle by circular shapes and diamond motifs in green. The background inside the main mosaic area is filled with small, white tesserae, interspersed with yellow, and occasional red, blue, and green pieces that contribute to the visual complexity of the pattern. The overall composition is symmetrical along both the vertical and horizontal axes of the rectangular panel. The empty space outside the mosaic frame is off-white.
title: Mosaic Pattern in Doorstep
